title: Texas Trash Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful chicken casserole featuring refried beans, enchilada sauce, cream cheese, and green chilies.
steps: Pour enough enchilada sauce to cover the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Ploop scoops of refried beans into the enchilada sauce.
Place a piece of chicken on each pile of beans.
Make the sauce by combining softened cream cheese, diced green chilies, shredded cheese, enchilada sauce, and taco seasoning in a mixing bowl.
Whisk the sauce mixture until beautifully combined.
Ploop a scoop of the mixture on top of each piece of chicken and spread it out.
Bake in the oven at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven, cover with shredded cheese, and put back in the oven for five or ten minutes until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through.
Sprinkle with chopped green onions before serving.
notes:
You can serve this on top of rice, on a bed of lettuce, or inside a tortilla.
